title: Briefing for 2026-10-10
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-10: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Americans' debt problems are flashing a warning not seen since the Great Recession. Treasury's Bessent hires Trump's controversial former Fed board pick, Judy Shelton, as advisor. Inflation on many everyday items was entirely due to tariffs, NY Fed says. Inflation fears on the rise as one-year outlook in Fed survey hits highest level since May 2023. ICE came to town and left behind weakened economies. Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva.
global: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky criticises 'gift to Putin'. US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condemns as 'assault on rule of law'. Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake hits Panama, damaging buildings. Navi Pillay, former UN human rights chief, wins Nobel Peace Prize. Three men found guilty of murdering two Australian surfer brothers and US friend. Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices.
philippines: ‘Violation of privacy?’ Senate court takes down Sara Duterte trial livestream. LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. Bida ang saya: Is your fave Jollibee spot owned by Sara Duterte?. Financial analyst tells impeach court: Sara Duterte has P817M in undisclosed wealth.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
